#### **1. Who Said What (Sort by Date & Time)**

- **[Sara Farnya] (Product, Avicenna Research) – [Saturday, September 14, 2024, 20:09]:**

- Noted difficulties in accessing the instance, impacting monitoring and issue resolution.
- Requested collaboration with Pouya to address the issue.

- **[Jonathan BERNARD] (Role not specified, INSERM) – [Monday, September 16, 2024, 10:44]:**

- Indicated ongoing efforts to resolve the issue, expected to take the whole day or longer.
- Requested details from Pouya regarding the technical changes mentioned by Sara.

- **[Sara Farnya] (Product, Avicenna Research) – [Monday, September 16, 2024, 13:16]:**

- Provided an overview of the IP restriction issue, noting removal from the whitelist.

- **[Jonathan BERNARD] (Role not specified, INSERM) – [Wednesday, September 18, 2024, 11:54]:**

- **[Sina Ardalan] (Role not specified, Avicenna Research) – [Date not specified]:**

- Noted no need for server reboot and committed to ongoing monitoring.

- **Network Downtime:** Jonathan reports a network issue causing internet downtime since Saturday.
- **Whitelist Removal:** Sina points out removal of Avicenna's IPs from the whitelist, preventing server access.
